Rain drums a relentless rhythm against glass towers, blurring the frantic movement of umbrellas into a sea of shifting shadows. The air tastes of ozone and exhaust, thick with the hum of idling engines and distant sirens. Amidst the chaos, a quiet melancholy settles; the downpour acts as a veil, isolating each passerby in their own private world. It is a symphony of urban solitude, where the cold dampness of the night feels strangely comforting against the relentless, glowing pulse.
